tasks.task: Read-only task: use only this checkout; do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, or use the network. Explain how this repository's capability catalogue separates declared capability facts from readiness, and what it says about coverage and missing observations. Give the readiness dimensions and one short coverage statement. Return JSON with keys dimensions (array of strings) and coverage (string).

Read-only task: use only this checkout; do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, or use the network. List the four implemented read-only map types and report the default and hard caps for map bytes, page items and graph neighbourhood depth. Return JSON with keys types (array), defaults (object) and hard_caps (object).

Read-only task: use only this checkout; do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, or use the network. Describe what a map client receives when it asks for an unsupported capability or schema, and what happens to stale, cross-scope or malformed references. State the fallback rule and one thing that must never happen. Return JSON with keys unsupported (string), stale_or_cross_scope (string) and never (string).

Read-only task: use only this checkout; do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, or use the network. Describe what the work/evidence map joins together and what it deliberately omits from its records. Return JSON with keys joins (array) and omits (array).

Read-only task: use only this checkout; do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, or use the network. Read-only task: use only this checkout; do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, or use the network. Include one missing-tool example and one stale-data example.

Read-only task: use only this checkout; do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, or use the network. Read-only task: use only this checkout; do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, or use the network. Describe the file edit transaction's safety guarantees from preview through replacement.
